taxonomy.name: Catalogue of Life eXtended Release (CoL XR)
taxonomy.scope: Ray-finned fishes only; this filter does not include sharks and rays or every group commonly called fish.

limits: The SEAFDEC source is a historical program-activity table, not a fish survey or species checklist for Bal-on Reservoir.

The two GBIF searches cover only records indexed to the exact text Bal-on Reservoir in waterBody or locality, within the specified country and CoL XR taxonomic selection; spelling variants, missing locality fields, other fish groups and unindexed records are not covered.
Zero exact-name search results do not establish fish absence.
The source does not resolve the reservoir's municipality, boundaries, current condition, public access, fishing rules, or item-specific reuse rights.
nextAction: Seek a dated fish survey or independently licensed occurrence records with a resolvable Bal-on locality; keep this reservoir separate from similarly named localities and do not publish a species checklist until identity, taxonomy and reuse are reviewed.
